acceptance_checks: install-target --local-only, remove the migration state, then migrate plan exits 0 and lists the baseline as pending.
migrate apply --execute exits 0 and writes a valid state; a subsequent migrate status reports zero pending.
A genuinely invalid migration state produces '[shiki] error:' on stderr with a non-zero exit and no Python traceback.
The migration test contains no add_baseline_goal helper and is green.
doctor on the repaired target reports pass for both migration checks.
non_goals: Changing the migration registry or its requires chains
Changing doctor remediation strings beyond what the fix makes true
scope: Remove the platform-repo-only goal artifact from the baseline migration's required list, keeping the four layout entries, so migrations can apply in a target at all. Make MigrationError subclass ShikiError so failures use the [shiki] error: exit contract instead of a raw traceback. Delete the add_baseline_goal workaround from the migration test so the suite exercises the real target path.
test_command: bash scripts/test_shiki_migrations.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_doctor.sh && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
title: Make migrations applicable in a target repository
